title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD and related peer applications.
  • Identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to create and review functional specifications.
  • Support Product Supply requirements ensuring proper SAP configuration, development, and interface alignment (EDI, SAP PO, 3PL, etc.).
  • Work closely with business groups and developers to support, design, and enhance critical applications within SAP ECC 6.0 and integrated systems.

Business Process & System Analysis

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentation.
  • Translate end-user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary to drive efficiency.
  • Document process flows, requirements, design specifications, testing plans, and quality assurance outputs.
  • Coordinate and assist with system conversions and data migration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) with the India SAP support team.
  • Collaborate with local and international teams across Order Management, Physical Distribution, and other functional areas.
  • Assist key users in managing Work Requests (developments, enhancements, production support) including:
  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Manage project-related tasks, work request planning, and scheduling.
  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bilingual English – mandatory.
  • Proven experience in SAP SD with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Experience with SAP ECC 6.0, EDI integrations, SAP Process Orchestration, and related interfaces.
  • Solid background in system analysis, configuration, and functional specification development.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Experience working in self-directed environments and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and guide users through process and system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (requirements, specs, testing, QA).

Working Time

  • Must be available to work aligned with Client EST hours , considering the BRT time zone .


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

title: Preparador de Casos de Imigração Sênior
description:

Essa posição é para profissionais que já trabalham com imigração , entendem a estrutura dos casos e conseguem preparar processos com alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Se você ainda está aprendendo ou nunca trabalhou diretamente com esses tipos de caso, essa vaga não é para você.

• Preparação completa de casos de imigração

• Organização e revisão de documentos

• Montagem de pacotes de aplicação

• Suporte à equipe jurídica

• Controle de prazos e deadlines

• Garantir consistência e precisão nos processos


Casos com os quais você irá trabalhar

• T Visa

• U Visa

• VAWA

• Asylum

• Immigration Court cases


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência REAL com imigração americana

• Experiência direta com T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, Asylum ou Court (Sabe o que são?)

• Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e grande volume de documentos

• Profissional proativo e focado em solução de problemas


Diferenciais

• Conhecimento de processos em Immigration Court

• Experiência preparando casos humanitários complexos

Remote (Home Office)


Remuneração

Entre R$2.000 a R$6.000

(de acordo com experiência e performance)


Importante

Para se candidatar, inclua na aplicação:

1️⃣ Quantos anos você trabalha com imigração

2️⃣ Quais desses casos você já preparou:

T Visa / U Visa / VAWA / Asylum / Court

3️⃣ Em qual escritório ou empresa você adquiriu essa experiência

title: SAP S/4 HANA Finance Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones financieras de SAP S/4 HANA)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Manage, support, and assist in the design and implementation of the Financial Accounting and

Controlling template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by

merging business and IT needs, and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and

utilization.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and support the Finance Area in the SAP implementation project from an IT perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
  • Should have a strong integration knowledge between FI-SD, FI-MM, FI-PP
  • Should have a strong knowledge Bank master setup, electronic bank statement (EBS) configuration, and cash management.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with a minimum experience of 5 years.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline.

Desirable:

  • SAP Certification in SAP Financial Accounting/Controlling.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).


The Role


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client’s technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.


Technical Qualifications & Requirements


  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.


Why Join This Opportunity?


  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.


Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.



THE ROLE

The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers.

In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.

• Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.

• Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.

• Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.

• Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.

• Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope.

• Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.



WHAT IT TAKES

• Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.

• Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.g., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).

• Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.

title: Integration Analyst
description:

O que esperar de nós

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;
DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

\ "We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  • Application review
  • Technical conversation
  • Architecture discussion
  • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role;
instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a\ "bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.

What you'll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional\ "human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.

What you'll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.G., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.

Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again;
simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Professor De Francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job

Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).

Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)

Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%

Key Responsibilities May Include:

  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.

Experience- What you will bring

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.

Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

- Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

- Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

- This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

- Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

Why Join Us?

At CHEP, you'll be part of a global team driving innovation in supply chain solutions. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities for growth, and the chance to work on transformative technologies that make a real difference.

title: Media Buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer – Home Renovation / Roofing (Video-First)

Location

Remote

Full-time

About Us

We're a lean, A1 performance marketing team serving 30+ roofing contractors across the U.S., and we're scaling aggressively to 100+ clients.

No bloated layers. No politics. No babysitting.

We specialize in video-driven paid media systems that generate booked appointments and signed jobs for roofing and home renovation businesses. If you don't understand contractors, sales cycles, and how to turn ads into revenue — this is not the role for you.

If you do — you'll have autonomy, trust, and real impact.

The Role (Read Carefully)

We're hiring a Senior Media Buyer who can own campaign execution end-to-end for roofing and home renovation clients.

This is not a "strategy-only" role.

This is not a "just launch ads and wait" role.

You will:

  • Set up
  • Launch
  • Optimize
  • Scale

Video-first paid media systems across TOF / MOF / BOF.

You must understand how contractors think, how homeowners buy, and how to turn attention into booked jobs.

Core Responsibilities

1. Campaign Setup & Launch

  • Build and launch Meta (Facebook/Instagram) video campaigns for roofing & home renovation clients
  • Structure accounts cleanly (TOF / MOF / BOF separation)
  • Implement proper tracking, events, and reporting
  • QA everything before launch — no sloppy work

2. Funnel Ownership (TOF → MOF → BOF)

You must know how to:

  • Run TOF video ads for awareness and demand creation
  • Build MOF retargeting (video views, engagement, site traffic)
  • Execute BOF conversion campaigns (lead forms, landing pages, booked calls)
  • Diagnose where funnels break and fix them fast

3. Video Ad Performance Optimization

  • Analyze hooks, angles, creatives, and messaging
  • Kill losers fast, scale winners responsibly
  • Give clear feedback on what video content is needed to improve results
  • Understand what works specifically in roofing & home renovation

4. Client Readiness & Professional Conduct

  • You don't talk like a marketer — you talk like a business operator
  • Campaign updates are clear, calm, and confident
  • You understand contractor economics (job size, close rates, seasonality)
  • You protect the agency's reputation at all times

Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)

You must have:

  • 3+ years managing paid social campaigns
  • Direct experience in home renovation or roofing marketing
  • Proven results using video ads (Meta primarily)
  • Experience running full-funnel paid media systems
  • Strong understanding of lead quality, not just CPL
  • Ability to work independently without hand-holding

If you've never marketed roofing, remodeling, windows, HVAC, solar, or similar trades — don't apply.

Who You Are

  • Tactical, fast, and detail-oriented
  • Calm under pressure
  • Takes ownership and responsibility
  • Doesn't make excuses — fixes problems
  • Understands that performance >
    opinions
  • Wants to grow with a team scaling hard

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction
  • You blame platforms instead of fixing campaigns
  • You don't understand contractors or local service businesses
  • You want a "chill" role instead of a high-performance one

Compensation

  • Competitive base pay (based on experience)
  • Performance-based growth opportunities
  • Long-term role as we scale to 100+ clients
  • High performers will be rewarded. Period.

Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.

  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.

  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud.

description:
O Assistente de Equipamentos será responsável por apoiar diretamente os Coordenadores na execução das atividades operacionais da área, garantindo controle, rastreabilidade e integridade dos assets. Este profissional atuará no inventário físico, recebimento e identificação de equipamentos, atualização de sistemas, preservação, movimentação segura e preparação de materiais para Workshop e embarques offshore. É uma função essencial para assegurar organização, conformidade técnica e fluxo eficiente dos equipamentos no ciclo operacional.

Atividades:

  • Realizar o inventário físico dos assets, garantindo rastreabilidade, identificação correta e acurácia nos sistemas URSA e PeopleSoft.

  • Realizar movimentações seguras de equipamentos em pátio, racks e áreas de estoque, mantendo organização e práticas de 6S.
  • Apoiar na preparação de equipamentos para envio ao Workshop, incluindo embalagem, registro e documentação.
  • Acompanhar o retorno de equipamentos do Workshop, realizando conferência física e sistêmica e reportando eventuais desvios.
  • Suportar a preparação de equipamentos para embarques offshore, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Reportar desvios operacionais, anomalias técnicas e inconsistências de inventário aos Coordenadores de forma tempestiva.
  • Cumprir normas e diretrizes de segurança, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho organizado e disciplinado.

Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação Técnica Completa nas áreas de Mecânica, Eletrônica, Automação, Eletrotécnica ou áreas correlatas (obrigatório).
  • Desejável Ensino Superior em Administração, Engenharia e/ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas e componentes relacionados a ROV, Survey ou Tooling (desejável).
  • Noções de leitura de desenhos técnicos e uso básico de instrumentos de medição.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em controle de inventário, logística ou áreas operacionais.
  • Proficiência no pacote Microsoft Office.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services;
our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You'll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You'll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You'll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken);
confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You've contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

title: Engenheiro De Dados Gcp Sr
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR

Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.

Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT, com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL, garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

Analisar e reestruturar processos de ETL, facilitando a migração para a nova arquitetura de dados.

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções escaláveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Experiência sólida com DBT, modelagem de dados e práticas de orquestração de pipelines.

Conhecimento avançado em BigQuerye Looker e estruturação de dados no Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiência em SQL para otimização e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.

Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de scripts de transformação e automação de dados.

Conhecimento avançado em ETL (Informatica PowerCenter, Talend, DataStage, Hadoop e entre outras).

Experiência prévia em projetos de migração de dados e integração entre diferentes plataformas.

Diferencial: Vivência no setor financeiro e familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados.

Benefícios e Diferenciais:

Parceria com TotalPass para acesso a academias e atividades físicas.

Oportunidades de treinamento e cursos em tecnologias de dados.

Auxílio com certificações oficiais, com 100% de reembolso ou vouchers.

Parcerias com instituições de ensino para graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.

Contratação PJ.

Trabalho 100% remoto, atuando em cliente do segmento financeiro.

Sobre a ATRA:

A ATRA é referência em tecnologia e inovação, atuando há mais de 15 anos no mercado de engenharia de dados, data analytics, governança e privacidade. Somos parceiros de grandes empresas como Microsoft, Google, Informatica, Denodo, Atlan e BigID, desenvolvendo soluções que transformam dados em ativos estratégicos. Com um ambiente colaborativo e inovador, buscamos profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia e transformação digital.

description:

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.

FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.

We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.

What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.Js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.

Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team

You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.Js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome

Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience

Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction

Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil

How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm's balance sheet.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

  • Experience working within data centre commissioning or critical infrastructure projects.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior Api Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world's most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.

Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You'll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).

title: Quality assurance tester
description:

Location: Rio Di Janeiro, Brazil
Duration - Full time
Salary - Competitive
Job Description
Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients' toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.
In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.
When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will
Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, Event Bridge).
Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e. G. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Git Hub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features. Who we are looking for
Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, Dynamo DB, and Event Bridge.
Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or Type Script for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e. G. JIRA, Browser Stack).
Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. We offer
We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply,and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

title: Hr training analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Hr training analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.
