title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.
Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!
About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.
We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications:
Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience:
Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:
Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms. Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.
· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.
· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.
Requirements
· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).
· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.
· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.
· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.
· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.
· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).
· Clear and structured written communication skills.
· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.
Differentials
· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).
Benefits
· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.
· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.
· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development
Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.
Location: Brazil
The Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M& A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M& A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.
The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M& A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.
Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M& A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M& A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M& A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M& A leadership to qualify M& A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units. Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M& A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M& A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency. Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Risk control analyst
description:

Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft, and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.

Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database, and summarize behavioral characteristics.
Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring, and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
Analyze existing risk management processes and policies, and provide recommendations for improvement.
Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions. Requirements

1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
Data analysis experience is a plus.
Strong communication and written skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
Strong logical thinking and analytical ability, capable of breaking down complex data.
Fluency in Chinese is required.

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:

We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.
● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.
We're looking for someone who is:
● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the "why" behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.
● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.
● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.
Bonus if you have:
● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.
● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).
● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team
● Early access to product features and training sessions

title: Advogado(a) pleno
description:
Na Ecopetrol Brasil, nosso compromisso é fornecer energia que transforme o futuro, alinhando desenvolvimento sustentável e inovação tecnológica. Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.
Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil!
Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para atuar em modelo híbrido, em nosso escritório localizado em Botafogo – RJ.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Assessorar a empresa em questões regulatórias junto à ANP, CNPE, MME e demais órgãos reguladores;
Apoiar na condução de processos administrativos regulatórios, incluindo cessões, atualizações cadastrais, submissão de documentos e diligências junto à ANP;
Analisar, revisar e elaborar contratos típicos do setor, como JOAs, SPAs, contratos de consórcio, concessão e partilha de produção, GSAs, GTAs, MOUs;
Revisar e aprimorar contratos corporativos padrão, manuais, políticas internas, mitigando riscos jurídicos;
Elaborar e revisar documentos legais e regulatórios do setor, incluindo licenças, certidões, contratos de exploração e produção e pareceres sobre normas de órgãos reguladores;
Preparar documentação para inscrição e qualificação em licitações e leilões da ANP, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos;
Prestar suporte legal contínuo às áreas corporativas, garantindo conformidade regulatória e corporativa;
Participar de fóruns da indústria, interagir com órgãos reguladores e apoiar na interface com escritórios de advocacia externos;
Apoiar controles internos e auditorias jurídicas, regulatórias e corporativas;
Identificar riscos legais e regulatórios, propor soluções preventivas e monitorar mudanças na legislação aplicável à indústria de exploração e produção. Requisitos e qualificações:
Graduação em Direito;
Atuação comprovada em contratos corporativos;
Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;
Inglês avançado/fluente;
Espanhol será considerado diferencial. Conhecimentos técnicos:
Sólido conhecimento da legislação brasileira, especialmente societária e corporativa;
Desejável conhecimento das normas e regulamentações aplicáveis à indústria de E& P;
Habilidade de análise, síntese e antecipação de riscos jurídicos e regulatórios.

description:

Atuar com administração avançada em Microsoft 365, incluindo : Exchange Online, Intune, Sharepoint, administração de teams, Microsoft Defender (endpoint/identity/email), Entra ID (Azure AD) e políticas de segurança aplicáveis.

• Formação em TI (ou áreas correlatas) ou experiência equivalente comprovada.

• Domínio prático de Microsoft 365 (administração e troubleshooting), suporte a endpoints e conceitos de rede.
• Inglês avançado/fluente
• Excelente comunicação, postura e capacidade de lidar com público executivo (VIP).
• Organização e disciplina para documentação e controle de processos.
• Proatividade, senso de urgência e atuação madura em situações críticas.
Diferenciais
• Certificações: ITIL, MS-900, MS-102, AZ-104 (ou equivalentes Microsoft).

• Conhecimento em automação (ex.: Power Shell) e melhoria de processos.
• Vivência com ferramentas de MDM/RMM/Inventário (Intune, Manage Engine, etc.) e segurança de endpoint.
Queremos um mundo de todos, com todos e para todos. Acreditamos na potência de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade em todas as suas formas de expressão, respeitando a individualidade de cada um. Se você quer sonhar e fazer acontecer, venha ser um Rock Lover!

description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing
As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.
Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team's evolution.
Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
Participate in Training: You'll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team. What we are looking for
Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business: Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
Analytical and Practical Mindset: Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem: Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit: You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team. What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)

Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of marketing

Entrepreneurship: you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won't give up until we make a huge dent in this industry! Come join us!

• Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments
It's ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Careers & university coordinator
description:
Careers & University Coordinator (Whole School)
Key responsibilities:
Strategic leadership and curriculum development
Curriculum Development: Develop and implement a progressive careers curriculum, integrating it with the school's IB programs and collaborating with Pastoral Leads and IB Coordinators to embed careers and life skills into the pastoral framework.
Training and Management: Lead the training and development of Year 12 and 13 Tutors and Heads of Year to provide consistent, high-quality university application support, ideally maintaining the same staff with each cohort for continuity.
Technology Integration: Manage and utilize an online central hub for all careers resources, communications, and student progress tracking.
Technology Integration: Ensure careers counselors have the tools and assessments needed to evaluate students' strengths and interests, guiding them toward suitable academic and career pathways. Higher education guidance and admissions:
International admissions expertise: Provide expert guidance on domestic and international university applications, with strong knowledge of UCAS (UK), the Common Application (US), European systems, and the Brazilian Vestibular process, while maintaining close relationships with university admissions departments.
Specialized counseling: Provide targeted support for highly competitive applications, including Oxbridge-level counselling for the University of Oxford, the University of Cambridge, and Ivy League/top-tier US institutions.
Application management: Oversee all aspects of the application process, including setting and enforcing deadlines for student and teacher components, and ensuring transcript quality and accuracy. Events, outreach, and student experience:
Parent presentations: Design and deliver parent presentations that clearly communicate admissions processes, funding options, and career pathways.
Alumni and local experts network: Support the development and maintenance of a strong alumni and local expert network to provide mentoring, career insights, and resources for current students.
School communication: Ensure timely and effective communication regarding all career
sevents, deadlines, and news across the whole school.
International Cultural Development: Support the school leadership team in promoting global citizenship, international mindedness, and aspirations for international study. Requirements
Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential to effectively guide students and communicate with both local and international universities and parents.
Proven teaching experience at the secondary level, preferably within the IB framework.
Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, International Relations, HR or related fields, besides proven experience and demonstrable knowledge of the UCAS, US, European, and Brazilian university admissions processes.
Proven ability to build a comprehensive strategic vision in partnership with leadership colleagues to create buy-in from stakeholders and hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-today delivery of this vision.
Exceptional ability to build rapport with students, parents, university representatives, and colleagues. Strong oral and written communication skills.
Excellent organizational, administrative, and project management skills.

Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates What We're Looking For
4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships What This Role Is NOT
This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.
Time Commitment
Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.
Pay
$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.
If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior estimator
description:
Company Overview:
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
Job Overview:
The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within Mc Dermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate
Gather information and input from functions with support from the project manager
Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues
Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items
Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE)
Review and identify contract price form
Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns
Essential Qualifications and Education:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering is a plus
5+ years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in estimating, project controls, and data analytics)

description:
A JUIT é uma legaltech (startup do ramo jurídico). Nosso objetivo é otimizar a pesquisa jurídica para operadores do direito, estruturando dados do Judiciário brasileiro em uma plataforma de busca e jurimetria.
Iniciamos nossas atividades em 2018 e desde então já tivemos diversos reconhecimentos, seja em inovação ou na área de tecnologia.
Vaga
A equipe de Engenharia de Dados da JUIT concentra-se em estruturar e potencializar grandes volumes de dados jurídicos provenientes de múltiplas fontes públicas e privadas. Por meio de arquiteturas robustas, pipelines escaláveis e técnicas avançadas de processamento de dados, o time transforma informações brutas e heterogêneas em ativos confiáveis, estruturados e prontos para geração de valor.
Nossa engenharia atua em todo o ciclo de vida do dado: da coleta e ingestão, passando por tratamento, normalização e enriquecimento, com pipelines de IA, até a disponibilização para produtos, API's e modelos inteligentes. Trabalhamos continuamente para elevar a qualidade, a consistência e a rastreabilidade das informações, garantindo que cada dado entregue pela JUIT contribua diretamente para decisões mais seguras, eficientes e estratégicas no contexto jurídico.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Jr para fazer parte do nosso time de coleta e ingestão de dados (Collect & Ingestion).
ATENÇÃO: Candidatos fora do perfil serão ignorados.
O que você fará:
Desenvolver soluções para coleta e ingestão de dados;
Atuar em conjunto com nosso time de engenharia para publicar serviços de dados para uso interno e externo de forma escalável e observável;
Coletar, mapear e analisar dados de diversas fontes, estruturadas ou não;
Trabalhar em conjunto com nosso time de segurança para garantir políticas de segurança de dados e compliance;
Desenvolver frameworks de testes para melhorar e garantir a qualidade dos dados coletados;
Monitorar e documentar o status de scrapers em produção e soluções já implantadas;
Definir e implementar métricas para monitoramento de cargas de trabalho, alinhadas aos frameworks utilizados, incluindo indicadores de SLA, SLO e SLI, para garantir observabilidade e desempenho consistente. Requisitos:
Formação superior em exatas (Ciências da computação, engenharia ou áreas relacionadas);
Sólidos conhecimentos em Python (2+ anos de experiência);
Conhecimentos em linguagem SQL (+1 anos de experiência);
Experiência com coleta de dados da web (web scraping, web crawling, RESTful API's, datasets públicos);
Sólidos conhecimentos em algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
Conhecimentos em desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD);
Conhecimentos em Docker;
Inglês intermediário. Diferenciais:
Experiência com processamento e extração de dados de documentos (. DOCs,. RTFs,. PDFs, etc);
Experiência com motores de busca de texto como Elasticsearch, Solr, Open Search, Sphinx, Amazon Cloud Search, Vespa e afins;
Experiência com desenvolvimento nas linguagens Golang e/ou Rust;
Experiência com pelo menos uma linguagem de programação baseada na JVM (Java, Scala, Clojure, etc.);
Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Pulumi, Chef, Ansible, etc.);
Experiência com coleta de dados de mídia (áudio e vídeo) e sua transcrição para texto;

title: Sap s/4 hana application architect - product management (arquitecto de aplicaciones sap s/4 hana - gestión de productos) - end-user support/consultant
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.
Primary Job Purpose
Responsible to support and assist in the design and implementation of the Supply Chain Operations template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by merging business and IT needs and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and utilization.
Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.
Key Position Accountabilities
Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP MM (Materials Management) and Variant Configuration related system configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units. SELECTION CRITERIA
Essential:
Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.
Understanding on SAP Best Practices and knowledge in Master data, MM module, their integrations & technology.
Ability to learn new tasks quickly; demonstrate flexibility when presented with change.
Lead and support a team environment.
Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline Desirable:
SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.
Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4 HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS
Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
Health and Safety accountability statements.
Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis. We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

title: Dental insurance posting agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.
As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you'll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You'll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.
About i Core
i Core is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.
We are more than a software company. i Core Connect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.
Behind i Core Connect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We're proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.
Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.
Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.
Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.
Objectives:
Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns Competencies:
Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
Full English proficiency
Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
Ability to pass job-specific assessments Benefits:
Personal:
Be a valued leader, not just a trainer You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.
Make a real difference at scale Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices, and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.
Work with a mission-driven team You'll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.
100% remote – work from home Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.
Better work-life balance While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.
Stability and long-term growth Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.
Professional:

Work with industry leaders in dental Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.
Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.
Build and lead teams Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.
Expand your industry network Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.
Develop enterprise-level experience Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

title: Frontend engineer – next.js / react

Build production-grade testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2 E) to support safe continuous deployment
Ship features end-to-end: idea → build → optimize for robust testing, speed and UX

Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.js apps
Are skilled at state management in large, complex apps
Believe testing is part of building, not an afterthought
Care about performance, UX, and clean design systems
Communicate clearly, move fast, and thrive in a startup culture
Bonus Points For
Experience with ad APIs (Meta, Tik Tok, IG)
Prisma + My SQL experience
CI/CD pipeline knowledge (Vercel, Git Hub Actions)
Join Us If You Want To...
Build alongside experienced engineers and founders
Work with a modern stack and ship fast
Solve hard UX and state management challenges in adtech
Own what you build and shape our engineering culture
Grow into a Lead role as the company scales
How to Apply

You will work across the entire stack — from Python-based AI orchestration services and data pipelines to the React-based interfaces that bring those capabilities to enterprise users every day.

Collaborate closely with AI/ML, Design, and Product teams to ship features end-to-end

Debug and trace issues from the UI through the API layer to backend services
Participate in code reviews and help raise the overall engineering bar Requirements
5+ years of professional engineering experience shipping production software
Strong proficiency in Python with experience building backend services (Fast API or similar)
Strong proficiency in React with experience in Next.js and Type Script
Solid understanding of API design, state management, and component architecture
Hands-on experience with AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Dynamo DB)

Comfort working across the full stack — you don't need to be told where the problem is
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows

title: Quality assurance engineer
description:
About the Company
Fully remote American software company founded in 2013. Focused on building tools and solution to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.
Their Job Description:
Why We're Looking for Contractors
As our customer base grows, so does our team. We're committed to delivering top-notch software quality and ensuring every feature release goes smoothly. To keep up with the growing demand and maintain our high standards, we're looking for experienced Quality Assurance Engineers in Brazil who can help us scale QA efforts, maintain product integrity, and contribute to a collaborative dev environment.
Who We Want to Hire
To be a QA contractor with us, you should have 5+ years of experience in software development or QA engineering. You know how to plan and execute test strategies, create and maintain robust test suites, perform root cause analysis, and communicate your findings clearly. You don't just test software—you improve it.
You're great at spotting issues, solving problems, and helping developers build better code. Your detail-oriented nature, curiosity, and passion for quality assurance set you apart.
Since you'll be collaborating with our US-based development team, strong English communication skills are important. We'll occasionally have meetings to align on progress, share feedback, or collaborate in real time.
Let's Geek Out
If you're geeky like our QA team (hopefully you are), you'll probably want to know more about our stack and workflow.
Technologies & Tools
Frontend/Backend: Ruby on Rails, React, Graph QL, Postgres, Redis
Testing: Cypress, Minitest
Dev Ops: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Circle CI
Collaboration & QA Tools: Jira, Rubymine, Sentry You'll be using these tools to build, execute, and automate tests while helping us maintain and improve QA documentation and practices.
Our Core Values
Our values aren't just nice words on a wall (we don't have one). They drive how we work and who we hire:
Integrity – We're honest with ourselves and others.
People – We understand that people are the foundation of our company.
Care – We do our best work with purpose and intention.
Remarkability – We provide standout experiences.
Growth – We accept yesterday and improve today. Even as a contractor, you'll be expected to uphold these values in your work and interactions.
What You'd Work On
As a QA contractor, you'll work alongside our development and product teams on:
Planning, executing, and automating manual and regression tests
Writing test cases and acceptance criteria
Identifying, triaging, and tracking bugs
Monitoring releases using tools like Sentry and Slack
Collaborating on documentation and QA process improvements
Mentoring junior team members (as needed) You'll receive assignments, collaborate through Slack and Jira, and give feedback directly to your point of contact. We're open to your ideas—your voice matters.
Flexibility
This is a fully remote contractor role with flexible hours. You'll need to coordinate occasionally with our US-based team, but we value asynchronous work and understand time zone differences. You'll be free to manage your schedule as long as you deliver consistent, high-quality results.
Compensation
We offer competitive USD-based compensation, above typical rates in the Brazilian market. Here's what you can expect based on your experience and skills:

Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing. Why join this project?
This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour, you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.
Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant
Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Data analyst v
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL
Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição
A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.
O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.
O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.
O que você fará
Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics. Qualificações Mínimas
Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis
Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark).
Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Analista De Business Development
description:
Quem somos nós

Na Amaris Consulting, acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.

Descrição do cargo

Sua missão será criar, desenvolver e tornar rentável e sustentável a sua própria Unidade de Negócio, tendo controle operacional e estratégico sobre ela.

Para garantir o crescimento dessa estrutura, você atuará diariamente em cinco eixos principais:

  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.

Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Executivo De Contas
description:
Venha viver nosso propósito!

Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor".

Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.

· Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;

· Somos empáticospois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todoinstante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por umambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!

  • Buscar sempre que possível oportunidades de cross-sell e upsell.
  • Participar de reuniões de vendas e buscar as informações estratégicas necessárias para a tomada de decisão sobre os negócios.
  • Executar tarefas administrativas a fim de manter registro das negociações e interações relevantes com clientes.

  • Preparar apresentações para respaldar as negociações e aumentar as possibilidades de conversão de negócios.

  • Experiência na função;

  • Conhecimento demercado sobre a venda de grupos (Rooming List/ No Show/ Contratos/ Shoulder nights);

  • Ensino médio completo

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;

  • Alimentação realizada no hotel;
  • Kit recém-nascido;
  • Convênio com Drogaria Pacheco;
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino Superior, cursos de idioma e Informática;
  • Parceria com restaurantes próximos ao hotel;
  • Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA);

Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos:

description:
Especialista de Manutenção

Local: Itaboraí – RJ

Modelo: Presencial

Tipo de contratação: CLT

Sobre a Brunel

A Brunel é uma multinacional holandesa com mais de 50 anos de atuação e presença em mais de 40 países. Somos especializados em soluções de recrutamento, seleção e alocação de especialistas para setores técnicos e altamente regulados.

Sobre a oportunidade

A Brunel está apoiando um de seus clientes no recrutamento de um Especialista de Manutenção para atuar em uma planta industrial localizada em Itaboraí – RJ.

A posição terá papel importante no suporte às atividades de manutenção da unidade, contribuindo para a confiabilidade dos ativos, continuidade das operações e melhoria da eficiência dos processos de manutenção.

O profissional atuará em interface com as áreas de manutenção e operação, apoiando atividades técnicas, análise de falhas e organização de processos e documentação da área.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Garantir que os requisitos internos e externos de HSEQ sejam seguidos
  • Apoiar as atividades de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva
  • Garantir que as rotinas de manutenção preventiva contribuam para a confiabilidade dos equipamentos e continuidade da produção
  • Realizar inspeções de ativos e equipamentos
  • Controlar processos de calibração de instrumentos
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho de prestadores de serviços e fornecedores
  • Apoiar o planejamento das atividades de manutenção junto às áreas operacionais
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as operações para melhorar a eficiência dos equipamentos utilizando ferramentas de qualidade
  • Apoiar análises técnicas relacionadas a falhas e desempenho de equipamentos

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica ou Engenharia Elétrica
  • Experiência com rotinas de manutenção industrial, incluindo manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva
  • Experiência em inspeção e calibração de instrumentos
  • Experiência com gestão de serviços terceirizados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de problemas, como:
  • RCA (Análise de Causa Raiz)
  • 5 Porquês
  • Diagrama de Ishikawa
  • FMEA
  • RCM
  • Experiência em ambientes estruturados com documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais
  • Experiência com análise de indicadores de manutenção como MTBF e MTTR
  • Inglês obrigatório

Outras competências

  • Interpretação de desenhos técnicos mecânicos e/ou elétricos
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão de manutenção
  • Conhecimento das normas NR10, NR12 e NR20
  • Familiaridade com normas de gestão como ISO9000, ISO14000, ISO45000 e ISO50001
  • Excel avançado para análise de dados e dashboards

title: Tech Lead Devops
description:
Vaga: Tech Lead DevOps Senior

Atuação: Híbrida 3x na semana na Barra da Tijuca/RJ

Projeto: Prazo indeterminado

A Mouts busca por um(a) Tech Lead DevOps Senior, para atuar de forma híbrida no Rio de Janeiro, que será responsável por:

- Projetar, implementar e evoluir infraestruturas cloud na plataforma Azure (AKS, VNET, Storage, ACR, Service Bus, Firewall etc.)

- Gerenciar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes com práticas avançadas de RBAC, Network Policies, Ingress, GitOps e Service Mesh

- Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código com Terraform (módulos reutilizáveis, state management, workspaces)

- Estruturar pipelines CI/CD maduros no Azure DevOps com estratégias blue/green, canary e quality gates (SonarQube)

- Implementar e manter estratégias de observabilidade com Azure Monitor, Grafana/Datadog e distributed tracing

- Garantir segurança de ambientes cloud e Kubernetes: Key Vault, Managed Identities, Zero Trust, scanning de imagens

- Apoiar práticas de FinOps: rightsizing, tagging strategy e monitoramento de custos via Azure Cost Management

- Participar ativamente de incident management, postmortems e definição de SLA/SLO/SLI

HABILIDADES E EXPERIÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS:

- Experiência com DevOps, Infraestrutura Cloud ou áreas correlatas

- Experiência sólida com Azure: AKS, VNET, ACR, EventGrid, Service Bus, Defender, Firewall, Application Gateway

- Kubernetes avançado: Helm, ArgoCD/Flux, OPA/Gatekeeper, Istio/Linkerd

- Redes: arquitetura Hub Spoke, DNS, VPN, Jumpserver, Conditional Forwards

- Terraform: módulos, remote backends, workspaces e boas práticas de IaC

- Containerização: Docker multi-stage builds, otimização de imagens, image promotion

- Disaster Recovery: backup strategies, geo-redundância, failover, RTO/RPO

- Scripting em Python e/ou Bash; administração Linux (networking tools, systemd, troubleshooting)

Se você gosta de desafios, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade!

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America's, particularly Argentina's, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1o de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica para expansão de capacidade, purificação para biometano ou ampliação da geração de energia.
  • Profissional com experiência comprovada em gás combustível de fonte renovável e Unidade de disposição final de resíduos sólidos, com atuação direta na gestão, monitoramento e análise de indicadores operacionais e ambientais do sistema de extração e aproveitamento energético do gás gerado por digestão anaeróbia.
  • Sólida vivência em sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH4), oxigênio (O2) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Position: Electrical Engineer

Location: Rio de Janeiro - Barra da Tijuca

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and reliable operation of electrical systems onboard the FPSO, contributing to performance improvement, asset integrity, and operational efficiency. The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;

Develop technicalsolutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;

Provide technicalsupport to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;

Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;

Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;

Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced English;

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;

Strong analyticaland problem-solving skills;

Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;

Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.

Nice to have

Knowledge of power generation systems, load shedding, switchboards, or HV/LV electrical systems.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;

- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;

- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;

- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;

- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;

- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;

- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;

- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.
